model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the measured "effect" across nine categorical language families for six distinct items. The horizontal category axis is labeled "family" and displays the groups from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical value axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 10, showing values of 0, 10, 20, and 30, with the axis extending slightly below zero. Within each family category, up to six contiguous bars are grouped side-by-side, corresponding to items defined in an overlying legend. These components are color-coded as light blue (featuring a partially obscured label), dark blue labeled "XLM-L2", light green labeled "mBERT-R2", dark green labeled "XLM-R2", light pink labeled "mBERT-B2", and dark red labeled "XLM-B2". Every bar is visually emphasized with a uniform black outline and a centered, vertically capped black error bar indicating variance. The charted values range widely across both categories and models, capturing negative values such as the light green Semitic bar at approximately -3 and the dark green IE-Germanic bar near -1. The highest values are observed in the IE-Indic group, where the light pink bar peaks at approximately 24, and in the Semitic group, where the dark red bar sits near 20 with an upper error bar reaching nearly 35. In contrast, the Isolate and Uralic families display the lowest consistent magnitudes, with all individual bars resting close to the zero line, between approximately 0 and 2.
